statement: Fr. John Fallon, Catholic mission on Bathurst Island (1958-1970), shook and destroyed Pukumani (sacred burial) poles belonging to Minnipinni (Thomas Woody's father), continuing after being asked to stop. Fallon himself later described his motive as being "fired by zeal to convert souls and destroy idolatrous practices" and expressed regret; the episode reportedly triggered a rethink of Catholic mission strategy on the Tiwi Islands.

sources.citation: ABC Religion & Ethics, "Tiwi Christianity: Aboriginal Histories, Catholic Mission, and a Su[bversive Faith]."
